A Canon Medical Systems do Brasil trabalha em ser referência na alta tecnologia em diagnóstico por imagem e oferecer soluções inovadoras que permitem melhorar o seu negócio e resultados dos pacientes.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in France, Brazil & India, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. The technical side is key to achieve a seamless experience for all, thus you will be at the heart of all key projects for MoveUp Media. Our team has a central platform to facilitate a well organized approach.

The Role

As a WordPress developer, you will be responsible for:

  • Working inside our custom WordPress engine (themes, plugins, internal tools).
  • Build and maintain advanced Gutenberg blocks, leveraging hooks, APIs, and custom theme logic.
  • Optimize database queries and code execution (profiling, debugging, chasing wasted milliseconds and memory leaks).
  • Integrate with REST APIs and support complex integrations/microservices.
  • Work daily in Docker/Podman environments (WP-CLI, container operations, Linux commands).
  • Collaborate with front-end integrators to connect blocks/themes while owning the backend architecture.

Required Skills

To excel in this role, you will need to master the following skills:

  • Deep expertise in PHP and the WordPress ecosystem (hooks, APIs, plugins, themes, Gutenberg).
  • Strong SQL skills and proven experience optimizing queries for performance.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and microservice integration patterns.
  • React experience, especially for Gutenberg block development.
  • Comfortable with Docker/Podman workflows and Linux environments (WP-CLI, file manipulation, container ops).
  • A performance-minded developer: profiling, measuring, and optimizing code execution.
  • MacOS or Linux development environment (mandatory).
  • Good command of HTML, CSS (SCSS), and JavaScript (ES6).
  • Experience working closely with designers and front-end integrators.
  • Awareness of accessibility and Core Web Vitals best practices.

The ideal profile

We are looking for a professional with over 4 years of experience in web development and WordPress. You must be meticulous and detail-oriented, while having a strong team spirit and the ability to take initiative. Autonomy and a passion for technology will be major assets, as well as a focus on quality and application performance.

Next steps in the process ✅

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements, followed by a possible technical test
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you ✨

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Attractive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location.
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly Workation — a mix of work and vacation . Once a year, we find a cool place to work and have fun together.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future!

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Especialista em Sistemas (Owner’s Engineer)
description:
Responsabilidades da posição:

Integração e validação de sistemas (visão “cliente/owner’s engineer”)

  • Consolidar e gerir a matriz de requisitos (funcionais e não funcionais), interfaces e critérios de aceitação, conectando edital/contrato, projeto, obra, testes e operação.
  • Conduzir a governança de interfaces entre sistemas (arquitetura, protocolos, dados, cibersegurança, redundâncias, disponibilidade), alinhando projetista, construtora e fornecedores.

Validação de engenharia, construtibilidade e O&M:

  • Revisar e validar especificações e arquitetura de sistemas, sem atuar como “autoridade técnica do fornecedor”, e sim como validador do atendimento aos requisitos e à integração ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir que os sistemas estejam planejados para operação e manutenção (O&M), incluindo acessibilidade, segregação, redundância, monitoramento, manutenção preventiva e suporte.
  • Apoiar decisões de engenharia de valor e gestão de riscos (obsolescência, lead time, compatibilidade, dependências de energia/dados, comissionamento e confiabilidade).

Testes, comissionamento e prontidão operacional

  • Estruturar, revisar e acompanhar a estratégia de testes e comissionamento: FAT/SAT, testes integrados (SIT), testes de aceitação, cenários de emergência, treinamento e handover.
  • Validar planos e evidências de desempenho dos sistemas, com rastreabilidade (requisitos → testes → resultados → pendências → aceite).
  • Apoiar a definição de requisitos de operação do CCO/CCM e rotinas de resposta a incidentes.

Sistemas no escopo (cobertura completa e integrada)

  • Free Flow + controle de tempo de percurso
  • Monitoramento 100% CFTV + sensoriamento de tráfego
  • Sensoriamento de tráfego com controle de velocidade
  • Rede de dados (fibra) com estações repetidoras
  • CCO
  • PMVs
  • Sinalização de emergência e abandono
  • Comunicação de emergência (megafonia e radiofonia)
  • Identificação automática de emergência
  • Combate a incêndio
  • Rádio
  • Iluminação
  • Ventilação
  • Eletrificação (AT/MT/BT, subestações, geradores, nobreak)
  • Cancela automática

Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

  • Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de especificações, projetos, memoriais, listas de interfaces, critérios de aceitação e planos de testes, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação.
  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista, construtora, integradores e fornecedores, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de escopo, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).

Suporte à obra e entrega (As Built)

  • Acompanhar tecnicamente instalação, energização, integração e testes em campo, apoiando liberações, inspeções, tratamento de não conformidades e validação de desempenho.
  • Garantir o pacote As Built, com atualização de modelos/documentos, registros comparativos e evidências de conformidade dentro dos prazos definidos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com sistemas de infraestrutura crítica (túneis, rodovias, mobilidade, aeroportos, portos, utilidades), com atuação em elaboração de projetos, integração, comissionamento e/ou operação.
  • Capacidade de atuar como integrador/validador do lado do cliente, gerindo requisitos, interfaces e critérios de aceitação ao longo do ciclo completo.
  • Vivência com testes e comissionamento (FAT/SAT/SIT), documentação de evidências e gestão de pendências até aceite.
  • Conhecimento prático de arquitetura de sistemas (rede/telecom, energia, automação/sensoriamento, CCO) e integração entre subsistemas.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório; fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em sistemas de túneis (ventilação, incêndio, emergência, CFTV, PMV, rádio, energia, automação e CCO).
  • Vivência com requisitos de disponibilidade, redundância, cibersegurança e integração via protocolos/arquiteturas (ex.: IEC, OPC, IP, NTP/PTP, SNMP, etc.).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados e com forte governança de interfaces e aceitação.
  • Familiaridade com abordagem RAMS e requisitos de confiabilidade/segurança (quando aplicável).

title: Gerente de Projetos - Saneamento
description:
QUADRANTE – Grupo internacional de engenharia, com forte atuação em Energia, Mobilidade e Cidades Sustentáveis, e presença crescente em projetos financiados por instituições financeiras internacionais.

Buscamos um Gerente de Projetos experiente e estratégico para liderar a gestão de projetos de saneamento. O profissional ideal terá um profundo conhecimento técnico em projetos de saneamento, incluindo sistemas de abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, redes, adutoras e coletores, associadas a Quadrante junto aos nossos clientes em todas as fases do projeto.

Esta posição é fundamental para orquestrar as entregas, garantir a comunicação eficaz com o cliente e assegurar que os projetos avancem em alinhamento com os padrões de excelência da Quadrante, em estreita colaboração com as equipes técnicas e a diretoria de operações.

Responsabilidades:

• Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de saneamento (abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, ETEs, ETAs, redes, adutoras e obras associadas), assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa e com os requisitos contratuais.

• Atuar como principal ponto focal técnico e gerencial perante o cliente, mantendo comunicação clara, tempestiva e estruturada em todas as fases do projeto, fortalecendo relações de confiança e garantindo o correto entendimento das necessidades e expectativas.

• Gerenciar integralmente o escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, riscos e recursos dos projetos, aplicando metodologias consolidadas de gerenciamento (PMI, PMBOK, Agile adaptado a engenharia, ou similares), garantindo entregas dentro dos padrões acordados.

• Coordenar o desenvolvimento técnico junto a equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia sanitária, hidráulica, ambiental, civil, geotecnia, topografia, BIM, orçamento e planejamento), garantindo integração entre disciplinas e consistência técnica entre os produtos entregues.

• Acompanhar a evolução física e financeira dos projetos, realizando reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com líderes de equipe, identificando desvios, implementando ações corretivas e comunicando riscos antecipadamente ao cliente e à direção interna.

• Gerenciar o contrato de forma estratégica: acompanhar termos, escopo contratado, aditivos, medição de serviços, fluxo de entregáveis, negociação de pleitos e suporte direto às áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações quanto a compliance e obrigações contratuais.

• Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos entregues por atenderem os desempenhos operacionais e econômicos requeridos pelas boas práticas e pelas Normas Técnicas brasileiras produzidas pela ABNT ou na falta delas normas ASTM ou ISO e diretrizes das Concessionárias, as normas ambientais e de segurança aplicáveis.

• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e apresentações executivas para direção e clientes, consolidando status de projeto, risco, indicadores de desempenho, decisões pendentes e planos de ação.

• Mapear oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções técnicas, otimizações de processo, inovações e uso de tecnologias (BIM, SIG, modelagem hidráulica, automação de processos) para aumentar eficiência e agregar valor ao cliente.

• Representar tecnicamente a empresa em reuniões, workshops e visitas a campo, garantindo visão integrada das condições reais do sistema e alinhamento entre projeto, execução e necessidades operacionais.

• Promover um ambiente colaborativo, orientando equipes, fomentando boas práticas de gestão e assegurando comunicação fluida entre todas as disciplinas e partes envolvidas.

Formação & Qualificações

• Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Sanitária ou áreas correlatas.

• Registro profissional ativo (CREA).

• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Saneamento, Infraestrutura ou Gestão Empresarial (desejável).

• Certificações como PMP, CAPM, Prince2, Scrum Master ou similares são diferenciais valorizados em gerenciamento de projetos de engenharia.

Experiência Profissional:

• Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerenciamento de projetos de saneamento, incluindo:

– sistemas de abastecimento de água

– esgotamento sanitário

– redes, adutoras e coletores

– ETEs, ETAs, elevatórias

– obras de infraestrutura associadas

• Vivência em empresas de engenharia, consultoria, concessionárias de água/esgoto ou projetos públicos.

• Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares (hidráulica, civil, ambiental, geotecnia, BIM etc.).

• Histórico na gestão completa do ciclo de vida de projetos: planejamento, execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.

• Experiência em análise de contratos, aditivos, pleitos, medição e interface com clientes públicos e privados.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

• Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos:

– MS Project

– Pacote Office (Excel avançado)

– ferramentas de controle de indicadores (Power BI é diferencial)

• Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas técnicas:

– AutoCAD

– Civil3D

– softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, SEWERGEMS, WaterGEMS)

– BIM (Revit, Navisworks, ou familiaridade com metodologia)

• Conhecimento atualizado sobre:

– normas ABNT/NBR aplicáveis ao saneamento

– diretrizes técnicas de concessionárias (Sabesp, Copasa, Sanepar, BRK, Aegea etc.)

– legislações ambientais e regulatórias

– requisitos de licenciamento ambiental (LP, LI, LO)

Competências Comportamentais:

• Forte capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para representar a empresa frente a clientes e órgãos públicos.

• Capacidade de negociação, organização e visão crítica.

• Alta capacidade analítica para tomada de decisão.

• Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a resultados.

• Habilidade em gerir múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, com calma e eficiência.

Idiomas

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado é diferencial

title: Tax/Finance Supervisor
description:
Position: Tax/Finance Supervisor

Location: São Paulo/SP – On-site

Responsibilities

Professional with a solid career in the areas of tax, finance, and accounting, with experience in multinational companies and shared services environments. Extensive experience in direct and indirect tax management, compliance, tax planning, and team leadership. Fluent English is required for daily meetings with the company’s headquarters (China).

Technical Skills

  • Tax Management: DAS, ICMS, ICMS-ST, ISS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL, INSS, IRRF, and CPP.
  • Ancillary Obligations: Preparation, review, and submission of SPED Fiscal, GIA, GIA-ST, EFD Contributions, DCTF, PER/COMP, STDA, DMED, DIRF, ECF, among others.
  • Compliance and Audits: Handling internal and external audits, as well as federal, state, and municipal inspections, with a focus on risk mitigation.
  • Tax Planning: Monitoring of special tax regimes in various states, analysis of tax opportunities, and reduction of the tax burden.
  • ERP and Systems: Implementation and configuration of tax modules.
  • Tax Legislation: Reading and interpreting regulations related to ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IR, and other taxes.

Experience and Results

  • Reorganization of the tax and financial operational controls area , implementing improvements and conducting operational risk and compliance assessments.
  • Leading budget and tax planning projects , resulting in a significant reduction in the tax burden.
  • Responsible for strategic meetings and reports directly with the international headquarters (China). Fluent English is required; Mandarin is a plus.
  • Dynamic and participatory leadership in team management, including hiring, onboarding, and training.
  • Effective performance in reviewing ECF , calculating taxes on revenue and services, intercompany transactions, and filing supplementary tax returns.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborative, dynamic leadership profile with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation skills, clear communication, and adaptability to new environments and roles.

About us

Blinq Tecnologia is a start-up company operating in the smartphone market with a focus on providing superior and affordable experiences for younger audiences. We have been operating in partnership with realme since 2018, the fastest-growing smartphone brand in the world, active in 61 markets globally, including China, India, Southeast Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa, with a total of more than 300 million users around the globe.

If you meet the criteria and want to be part of this story, send us your CV!

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer . You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Head of Gaming, Brazil
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

As the Head of Gaming, Brazil, you will lead strategic initiatives to enhance our gaming portfolio across Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo and will be responsible for the financial performance of gaming operations in the region, executing the strategy set by the CPO and ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy, while maximising player engagement and revenue growth.

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader with a proven track record in the iGaming industry who possesses strong commercial acumen, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of what makes an exceptional localised Gaming Product.

You will develop and execute a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to the Brazilian market, collaborating closely with the central Product team. This strategy will aim to achieve set financial targets for Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo in each market.

Your role will involve identifying growth opportunities and ensuring the delivery of product and content roadmaps in the region. You will leverage customer and data insights to inform strategies, working with marketing and CRM teams to ensure their approaches align with key product initiatives. Additionally, you will build and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in a senior role within the iGaming industry.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and operational excellence.
  • In-depth knowledge of games and game types within Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo.
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience in product development and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with supplier management.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation and enhancing player experiences.
  • Familiarity with market research and competitive analysis.

Additional Information

  • Developing and executing a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to Brazil while ensuring it meets and exceeds financial targets for gaming revenue.

  • Leveraging customer and data insights to inform strategies and decision-making, and conducting market research and competitive analysis to inform product development and identify emerging trends and customer needs.

title: AI-First Frontend Engineer (Next.js & React) - Remote
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)

Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.

You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.

Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the “Clinical OS” — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.

Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The “Beautiful Web” Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.

Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don’t bolt AI on — it’s embedded in how we build. You’ll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You’ll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: Technical Solution Manager (Energy Storage)

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Design & Optimization

• Lead the design of energy storage solutions across grid-side, generation-side (renewable + storage), and standalone/shared energy storage power stations

• Support project execution from design through construction and delivery

• Resolve technical issues related to electrical interfaces, communication protocols, and grid integration

• Provide technical support during operation & maintenance phases

• Track regional energy storage policies (capacity compensation, spot market rules, grid connection requirements, etc.)

• Analyze market dynamics and regional characteristics

• Contribute to white papers and technical roadmap reports for grid-side energy storage

6. Project Development Enablement

• Develop technical documentation such as:

• Utility-scale ESS development guidelines

• Grid connection FAQs

• Delivery & acceptance SOPs

• Deliver technical training to sales and project teams to accelerate commercialization

7. Competitive Analysis

• Benchmark leading competitors (e.g., Sungrow, HyperStrong)

• Conduct SWOT analysis and provide strategic insights

• Support product evolution in areas such as high-voltage cascade systems and liquid cooling technologies

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Engineering, or related fields

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in the energy storage industry

• Proven experience supporting utility-scale (100MWh+) energy storage projects is preferred

Technical Expertise

• Strong knowledge of primary and secondary electrical design for energy storage systems

• Familiarity with protection systems, grid compliance testing, and SCADA/communication protocols

• Experience with power system analysis; proficiency in simulation tools such as PSCAD or ETAP is a plus

Soft Skills

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to represent the company in technical reviews with grid operators, EPCs, and clients

Documentation Skills

• Excellent technical writing skills with the ability to produce structured, high-quality proposals and reports

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Júnior

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Executivo de Negócios com o foco em Expansão – Canal B2B (Investimentos)

Resumo da posição

Estamos assessorando uma das maiores gestoras de investimentos do mundo, reconhecida por sua atuação em fundos de índice e fundos mútuos, com presença global e foco em soluções de investimento de baixo custo para investidores institucionais e individuais.

Responsável por desenvolver e ampliar relacionamentos com distribuidores, consultores e demais intermediários no canal B2B, atuando via canais digitais, telefone e visitas presenciais, visando clientes de médio e alto valor.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Alcançar metas de vendas e retenção no segmento B2B.
  • Implementar estratégias comerciais para identificar e conquistar novos parceiros e oportunidades de negócio de qualidade.
  • Gerar resultados por meio de prospecção ativa e relacionamento consultivo, interagindo com clientes e prospects de forma virtual e presencial.
  • Criar e fortalecer relações com gestoras de recursos conectadas a assets, ampliando capilaridade de distribuição de produtos de investimento.
  • Entender a dinâmica e perfil dos intermediários e de suas carteiras de clientes, adequando a oferta de soluções.
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança, promovendo o conhecimento sobre produtos e serviços da empresa junto ao canal B2B.
  • Demonstrar domínio do mercado de capitais, setor de investimentos e tendências da indústria, posicionando-se como referência para clientes e prospects.
  • Representar a empresa em reuniões, treinamentos e eventos, gerando novas oportunidades e promovendo o portfólio de produtos.
  • Utilizar tecnologia virtual para potencializar o relacionamento em todo o território e apoiar a equipe de vendas externa quando necessário.
  • Participar de projetos especiais e cumprir outras demandas inerentes à função.

Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em vendas e relacionamento B2B no mercado de investimentos.
  • Ensino superior completo; pós-graduação é diferencial.
  • Desejável MBA, CFA ou CIM.
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação); espanhol avançado desejável.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.

Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Digital Platforms Training Specialist
description:
(We never request payment as part of our selection process and always contact candidates through our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are asked for payment, it is likely to be fraudulent. Please check that the role you are interested in is posted here on our website.)

TMF Group is a leading provider of administrative services, helping clients invest and operate securely around the world. As a global company with over 11,000 employees in more than 125 offices across 87 jurisdictions, we seek talented individuals with the potential to thrive at TMF Group, regardless of their background, and offer job opportunities to the broadest spectrum of people.   • Strong ability to learn new systems quickly; familiarity with modern learning technologies.

title: Tech Lead DevOps (Especialista em Plataforma/Cloud)
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista DevOps com forte experiência em ambientes de nuvem e automação para atuar na evolução da nossa plataforma tecnológica. Este profissional terá papel fundamental na construção, sustentação e melhoria contínua da nossa infraestrutura cloud, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) e práticas de segurança integradas ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.

A pessoa atuará diretamente na administração e evolução de ambientes em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , além de projetar e manter pipelines utilizando Azure DevOps , garantindo processos de entrega mais rápidos, seguros e confiáveis. Também será responsável por implementar práticas de DevSecOps , promovendo automação, observabilidade e governança em toda a jornada de desenvolvimento e operação das aplicações.

Buscamos alguém com mentalidade voltada para automação, qualidade e segurança , capaz de atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e segurança, apoiando na adoção de boas práticas de cloud e engenharia de plataforma.

Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar com tecnologias modernas de infraestrutura e contribuir para ambientes escaláveis, resilientes e seguros, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, garantindo qualidade e automação no ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de software;
  • Administrar, evoluir e otimizar ambientes em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade das aplicações;
  • Implementar práticas de DevSecOps, integrando ferramentas e processos de segurança ao pipeline de desenvolvimento e entrega contínua;
  • Gerenciar e evoluir infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou similares para provisionamento automatizado de ambientes;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e logging, garantindo visibilidade e performance dos sistemas;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, configuração e deploy de aplicações em ambientes cloud;
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, governança e boas práticas de arquitetura em nuvem;
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e arquitetura na adoção de práticas modernas de cloud, automação e segurança;
  • Atuar na identificação, análise e resolução de incidentes e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura e pipelines.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , incluindo serviços como: Compute Engine, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Run, IAM, VPC, Cloud Storage;
  • Domínio de Azure DevOps , incluindo: Pipelines YAML, Repositórios, Boards, Artifacts;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração , utilizando Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC) , utilizando Terraform ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de colaboração e gestão como Jira e Confluence;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com ferramentas de segurança de aplicações , como SAST, DAST, SCA, gestão de vulnerabilidades e Secrets Management;
  • Conhecimento em Linux e experiência com scripting (Bash, PowerShell ou Python);
  • Experiência com Git e controle de versionamento .

Consideramos como um diferencial:

  • Certificações em GCP (ex.: Professional Cloud Architect, DevOps Engineer);
  • Certificação Kubernetes (CKA ou CKAD);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog e Grafana;
  • Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud .

Perfil comportamental:

  • Mentalidade voltada para automação e melhoria contínua;
  • Forte foco em segurança e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva com times técnicos;
  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração entre áreas.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care, and body care brands.

At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and believe that beauty lies in diversity. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where all talents can shine and where different perspectives drive innovation and growth.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead end-to-end recruitment processes for strategic and complex roles across LATAM.

This position requires strong business acumen, stakeholder influence, and deep expertise in sourcing and assessment methodologies. You will act as a trusted advisor to leaders, ensuring excellence in delivery, data-driven decision-making, and an outstanding candidate experience.

This is an individual contributor role with high regional exposure and strong interaction with global stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for strategic and complex positions across LATAM markets;
  • Partner closely with senior leaders and hiring managers, acting as a talent advisor and influencing hiring decisions;
  • Conduct structured and competency-based interviews, ensuring high-quality assessment and cultural alignment;
  • Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies, leveraging talent mapping and headhunting techniques;
  • Drive diverse talent pipelines aligned with DE&I priorities;
  • Monitor and analyze recruitment KPIs, generating insights to continuously improve processes and hiring outcomes;
  • Ensure effective use of ATS systems and full compliance with internal policies and local labor legislation;
  • Contribute to Employer Branding and regional talent initiatives in partnership with global teams.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields;
  • Fluent English and Spanish (mandatory for regional scope and stakeholder interaction);
  • +5 years of solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with regional LATAM exposure;
  • Strong expertise in competency-based interviewing, talent mapping, and sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, etc.);
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights;
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

title: Energy Storage Operation and Maintenance Service Plan Engineer
description:
About Us

3.Over 2 years of experience in the new energy or energy storage industry, with service experience; project management experience is a plus.

4.Fluent in English, able to conduct in-depth business communication independently; proficiency in a second foreign language is a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity

CATU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employment Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. CATU reserves the right to modify, revise, or add job responsibilities as business needs evolve. Employment with CATU is at-will, meaning either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

Export Control & Data Security Compliance

This position may involve access to sensitive systems or information subject to U.S. export control and data security regulations. Employment is contingent upon the employee’s ability to comply with applicable laws and company policies related to data protection and controlled information access.

title: Advogado SR (ESG)
description:
Advogado SR (ESG)

Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na gestão das demandas de ESG da Arauco. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem o apoio em demandas ambientais, como licenciamento, defesas de autos de infração ambientais, pareceres técnicos, revisão de contratos da área, bem como a análise e mitigação de riscos ambientais, sociais e de governança.

O objetivo é garantir a conformidade legal, a segurança jurídica das operações nas melhores práticas de sustentabilidade dentro da companhia.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão demandas ambientais;
  • Elaborar defesas em processos administrativos;
  • Redigir documentos destinados a órgãos públicos ambientais e sociais;
  • Prestar consultoria e assessoria jurídica, interpretando e aplicando leis e regulamentações relacionadas ao direito ambiental e administrativo, bem como fornecer orientação jurídica às áreas de negócios e operações sobre questões ambientais.
  • Mediar e resolver conflitos relacionados a propriedades utilizadas pela Arauco, buscando soluções extrajudiciais sempre que possível, representando a empresa em processos judiciais e administrativos relacionados a questões de responsabilidade social;
  • Acompanhar o cumprimento dos prazos e obrigações contratuais relacionados a área de ESG;
  • Gerenciar a documentação de contratos e registros da área, garantindo a organização e acessibilidade dos documentos;
  • Apoio as atividades relacionadas ao licenciamento ambiental;
  • Cumprir e propagar a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

Local de atuação

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em ESG, Direito Ambiental ou áreas afins

  • Vivência em direito ambiental, preferencialmente em empresas do setor industrial, florestal ou de celulose e papel
  • Conhecimento em licenciamentos ambientais
  • Disponibilidade para viagens às unidades industriais/florestais.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams

YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

  • Experiência em gestão de equipamentos ou experiência na indústria de fabricação de transformadores ou equipamentos elétricos.
  • Certificados relacionados à gestão de equipamentos (como certificação CMMS).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho em turnos; boas habilidades de comunicação e coordenação.

Requisitos:

  • Gestão do ciclo de vida completo dos equipamentos: Experiência em gestão de equipamentos industriais; domínio da manutenção, diagnóstico de falhas e reparo dos principais equipamentos da linha de produção de transformadores (máquinas de bobinagem, sistemas de impregnação a vácuo, bancadas de ensaio de rigidez dielétrica, entre outros).
  • Inglês avançado (em nível de conversação)
  • Liderança de equipes e cooperação interdepartamental: Experiência na gestão de equipes de manutenção; capacidade de alocar recursos humanos de forma eficiente, elaborar escalas de trabalho e atuar em estreita colaboração com os departamentos de Produção, Qualidade e EHS.
  • Implantação de sistema de manutenção preventiva: Capacidade de elaborar e executar planos de manutenção preventiva (PM); aplicação do método TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total), reduzindo significativamente a taxa de falhas dos equipamentos e o tempo de parada não planejada.
  • Capacidade de conformidade com segurança e normas brasileiras: Sólido conhecimento das normas obrigatórias brasileiras, como NR-10 (segurança em eletricidade), NR-12 (segurança em máquinas e equipamentos), bem como das normas de SMS da fábrica, garantindo operação 100% em conformidade.
  • Melhoria contínua e consciência de custos: Otimização da eficiência dos equipamentos por meio da análise de dados de OEE; promoção de melhorias técnicas; controle adequado dos custos de manutenção e do estoque de peças de reposição.

title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay , our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required; Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.g., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.g., FIDC) preferred

Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Analista de Projetos (Foco em Gestão Financeira e Performance)
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Avaliar e validar propostas comerciais, garantindo viabilidade técnica e financeira;
  • Analisar cronogramas e assegurar aderência entre planejamento e execução;
  • Monitorar a evolução técnica dos projetos, identificando riscos e desvios;
  • Realizar análise contínua entre performance técnica e resultados financeiros (custo x receita);
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos projetos junto aos times envolvidos;
  • Gerenciar e atualizar o forecast de vendas, apoiando a previsibilidade do negócio;
  • Consolidar e estruturar dados para suporte à tomada de decisão gerencial;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas para stakeholders internos e clientes.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com análise financeira aplicada a projetos;
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos, margem e forecast;
  • Domínio de ferramentas financeiras (Excel avançado obrigatório; Power BI é diferencial);
  • Familiaridade com gestão de projetos (cronogramas, KPIs e entregas).

Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com diferentes níveis (técnico e executivo);
  • Capacidade analítica e visão crítica;
  • Organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas;
  • Perfil proativo e orientado a resultados.

Experiência

  • Experiência prévia em funções similares, atuando com projetos de média e alta complexidade;
  • Vivência em ambientes com interface entre áreas técnicas e financeiras.

Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente
